digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler mode contract and advisory lock
propositions: The complete MODE_CAPS mapping for all five legacy modes must be directly asserted in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_mode.py without changing production behavior.

The reconcile-check phase-gate value must round-trip through the real ref backend in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock.py, proving equal reconcile-check targets remain allowed while higher modes are blocked.
Mode enum and all legacy mode values, ordering, and caps must remain unchanged in production files.
The test suite must pass linting and type checking without adding production code changes.
